body:
Pass 33. Measured: your scale gate has EXCEEDED the 30-minute limit - 33m40s since the fixture-ready signal and still running, CPU 27m16s. runtime_pass will be FALSE.

Memory was never the constraint. Peak RSS ~2.4 GiB against 4 GiB and falling under gc, now 2.04 GiB. This path is runtime-bound, and my earlier memory-side projections were aimed at the wrong thing.

And it failed at the most favourable configuration available - q=2, 3 partitions, 6 edges, covariance singular for 84% of supports. Both fixes for that degeneracy multiply cost 5-6x, so a meaningful fixture is further out, not nearer.

Your acceptance clause is now the measured outcome. Suggested close for Epic 8:
  - brain-scale diagonal/identity metrics SUPPORTED - same 52k volume, 166s end to end
  - dense local metrics at whole-brain node counts NOT SUPPORTED in 0.1, exceeds 30 min
  - a declared dense-metric ceiling in node count and support size, found by re-running at reduced
    node counts until it fits

That is a stronger and more useful result than a pass. Full numbers on bd-01KZXWPKT4XPSB55PB5RBSAZRT.
